write_int_array: write a numpy int array to a serialized protobuf file in a given folder
load_int_array: load a serialized protobuf int array file from a folder into a numpy array
write_bitfield_array: write a numpy bitfield array to a base64-encoded protobuf file in a folder
load_bitfield_array: load a base64-encoded protobuf bitfield array file from a folder into a numpy array
graph_to_proto: convert a dm_alchemy Graph object to a protobuf GraphArray entry for serialization
